newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopia charges former officials with gassing 24.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopia charges former officials with gassing 24.

text.p: Two former Ethiopian officials appeared in court on Tuesday charged with torturing and gassing to death 24 people in the Red Terror campaign of 1977 and 1978.

Former Colonel Fantaye Yihedego and Lieutenant Haile Gebeyhu ordered the victims tortured before being subjected to poison gas in the towns of Kombolcha and Dessie in the northern region of Wollo, the prosecution said.
"(They) killed 24 persons, who they accused of being members of an opposition Marxist group, with posion gas," it added.
The two were part of Ethiopia's former Marxist military junta which was toppled in 1991, and served as members of the Revolutionary Campaign Coordinating Committee in Wollo.
Supporters of ousted dictator Mengistu Haile Mariam killed up to 100,000 people in the Red Terror campaign against suspected opponents.
The prosecution also said the two defendants ordered the death of 18 others accused of belonging to the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF).
A total of 71 former top officials of the Dergue, the junta that overthrew Emperor Haile Selassie in 1974 and ruled until 1991, are on trial charged with genocide and crimes against humanity.
